item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows two light balloons P and Q that Siddharth hangs a few centimetres apart. He blows a fast stream of air through the gap between them. The balloons move toward each other.

Which claim correctly decides how the fast-moving air changes the pressure?

options.A: Fast air between the balloons lowers the pressure there, so higher pressure on the outer sides pushes P and Q together.
options.B: Fast air between the balloons raises the pressure there, so that higher pressure pushes P and Q apart.
options.C: The balloons move together even when the pressure between them equals the pressure on their outer sides.
options.D: The balloons move together because they look round, whether the air between them is moving or still.
